title: Pause
one_line: Resume, sound, rules, leave. The only way out of a match, and the place a player calms down before rage-quitting.
gaps: Exists, but it is not on the NX Card chassis with Lucky Six corners.
No nameplate. No collar on the main action.
Leaving has no confirm step - one mis-tap forfeits the match and the stake.

anatomy.spec: ground.scrim at 72 percent. The board stays visible behind it - a paused player should see the position they are coming back to.
Standard NX Card, 380 wide, cream rim 10, Lucky Six corners.
Body 14 under the nameplate: what is at stake if they leave. 'Leaving forfeits +120 NX.' Omit the line entirely in Pass and Play.
One cream well (bible 5.6) holding three setting rows with toggles: SOUND, MUSIC, VIBRATION. Bible 5.11 toggles - 56 x 30, go green with a tick when on.
Two option amber buttons, size M, full content width, 8 pt apart: HOW TO PLAY, SETTINGS.
LEAVE MATCH, neutral kind, button M. NOT danger - danger is only allowed inside the confirm dialog (bible 2.2). It opens confirm-dialog.
RESUME, go green, button L, straddling the bottom edge in a 6 pt cream collar. The main action is coming back, not leaving.
44 cream disc, X, 24 pt below. Same as RESUME.

components: 5.8 Buttons (go L collar, option M, neutral M)

copy.title: PAUSED
copy.confirm_body: You forfeit the match and {N} NX. Your opponents keep playing.

states: Paused in a solo or bot match - the game clock stops completely.
Paused in an online match - the game does NOT stop. Say so plainly: replace the stake line with 'The match keeps going. Your turn will pass.' Never let a player believe they paused other people.
Pass and Play - no stake line, LEAVE MATCH says END MATCH, and the confirm says nothing about NX.
motion: Open and close: tokens.json motion.popupOpen / popupClose.
The board behind does not animate while paused in a solo match.
data: Toggles: SettingsService - the same values Settings writes, not a second copy.
do_not: Do not make LEAVE MATCH red or danger-coloured on this card. Danger lives inside the confirm dialog only (bible 2.2).
Do not let leaving happen in one tap. It forfeits a match and a stake.
Do not claim an online match is paused when it is not.
Do not duplicate the settings toggles' state - read and write SettingsService.
Do not hide the board behind an opaque card.
acceptance: Opens from the match top-left button, on the NX Card chassis with Lucky Six corners and a PAUSED nameplate.
RESUME is the main action, in a collar on the bottom edge.
LEAVE MATCH always goes through a confirm dialog naming exactly what is lost.
In an online match the card says the match keeps going.
The three toggles write to SettingsService and survive a match restart.
steps: 2. Rebuild the prefab on the standard NX Card chassis with the nameplate and Lucky Six corners.
3. Add the toggles well, reading and writing SettingsService.
4. Add HOW TO PLAY and SETTINGS as option buttons; wire HOW TO PLAY to rules-how-to-play.
5. Add LEAVE MATCH as neutral, opening confirm-dialog with the stake named in the body.
6. Add RESUME in a collar on the bottom edge and the close X below.
7. Handle the three states: solo, online, pass and play.
prompt:
Rebuild the Pause popup for Ludo NX.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 4.3, 5.21 and 2.2, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

It exists but it is not on the NX Card chassis, it has no nameplate, and leaving a match takes one tap - which forfeits the match and the stake.

Build it as a standard NX Card with a PAUSED nameplate, a line saying what leaving costs, a cream well holding SOUND / MUSIC / VIBRATION toggles, option buttons for HOW TO PLAY and SETTINGS, LEAVE MATCH in neutral, and RESUME as the main action in a collar on the bottom edge. RESUME is the main action - coming back, not leaving.

Two rules that are easy to get wrong: LEAVE MATCH is neutral tan on this card, not red - danger colour is only allowed inside the confirm dialog (bible 2.2). And in an online match, DO NOT say the game is paused, because it is not: say 'The match keeps going. Your turn will pass.' Never let a player believe they paused other people.

The toggles must read and write SettingsService, not keep their own copy.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
